notes: Version 2.0 aligns the note with the published status of every constituent. The step from the capacity exponent to the cascade exponent leaves the derivation chain: O24 closes the fibre-structure conditionality of c_chi -> delta_pair only and states that it does not establish the capacity-to-rate step, O25 and O14 report no beta* diagnostic from these data, and the Span-Growth Note proves the expander-derived conversion does not transfer to the Heisenberg substrate, so the agreement of beta* = 0.126 with the charged-lepton window is a coincidence check. The O31 record is a withdrawal notice, so the SU(3) identification, the colour-group derivation and every derivation of a gauge factor are withdrawn; the two H-color levels established in O32 stand and the two that rested on O31 are open. On the SU(2) side the su(2) identification is conditional on the neutral-sector identification O27 assumes and on the carrier O23 supplies, d_rho = 2 is O26's minimality selection, the adjoint reading of H_eff is supplied rather than derived, and O30's ratio is a conditional 3x3 model that gives no account of the covariance measured in O28. The Heisenberg/Weil carrier is recorded as supplied, HeisenbergStructure having disproved its selection from the axioms by a six-element countermodel. O4, O5, O15 and O21 are restated from their deposited abstracts, fifteen cited titles are synchronised after resolving every DOI in the file, and the Span-Growth Note, the Critical Coverage Note and O33 are added as constituents.
